The '''Firefrost Lavaworks''' was a lava smelting operation that was located in a cave underneath the [[Glacial Fissure]] region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Run by the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Gradak Ungan]] of the [[White Maw]] gang, the Lavaworks were accessible from an entrance in [[White Maw Pass]]. A [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] hunted down and [[Death/Legends|killed]] Gradak in the Lavaworks in an effort to draw out [[Reneget Vause]].<ref name="SWTOR" /> Around [[3630 BBY]],<ref name="Year">According to {{TORweb|url=community/showthread.php?p=9852711#edit9852711|text=Charles Boyd on Forums: "Dear Story Team, What Year Are We Currently In?" (1)}}, the updates released in 2016 took place in [[3630 BBY]]. Since {{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=uprising|Firefrost}} was released in update 5.0 which was released in 2016 we can assume that it took place in [[3630 BBY]].</ref> the facility was being ruled by [[Forgemaster]] [[Droub]], who was stockpiling weaponry within it. Soon after, the [[Eternal Alliance]]'s [[Alliance Commander|Commander]] led an [[White Maw Massacre|assault]] and freed Firefrost Lavaworks, eliminating all White Maw forces present.<ref name="FF">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=uprising|Firefrost}}</ref> Once Firefrost Lavaworks was secured and the civilian workers were rescued, the [[Eternal Alliance]] established themselves in the factory. The Alliance modified the factory to serve their purposes and civilian workers that were liberated by the Alliance decided to run the factory on their behalf.<ref name="Codex" />
